title: EiLearn
tagline: EiLearn is an AI-powered Web3 platform that helps users learn crypto trading through a decentralized trading game. Traders can practice with testnet coins, get AI-driven insights, and transition to real trading with fair, on-chain trade validation.
description: EiLearn is an AI-driven Web3 platform that teaches users about crypto trading and staking. Beginners can practice in a risk-free environment, while experienced traders can test strategies with AI advisors. All trades are verified on-chain using a decentralized system, preventing fraud and manipulation. AI-powered insights help users make better trading decisions, and rankings are based on fair and transparent trade validation.
how_its_made:
We built EiLearn using React, AI agents, and smart contracts to create a secure and fair trading platform. Smart contracts handle trade validation, rankings, and rewards, keeping everything on-chain for transparency.

AI advisors analyze market trends to give trade recommendations, while AVS (Actively Validated Services) uses multi-signature consensus to verify trades and prevent fraud. We also added fraud detection to catch wash trading and spoofing using historical data.

For security, we use EigenLayer, which punishes bad actors and ensures fair trade validation. We optimized the system for fast and low-cost trade verification and integrated blockchain oracles for real-time market data. Everything works together to provide a trustless, gamified, and educational trading experience.

For the user account system, we also tapped on Privy.
